---
name: Research / experiment
about: Propose a falsifiable research question, benchmark, reproduction, or experiment
title: "[Research] "
---

## Research question

What do we want to learn?

## Hypothesis

State a falsifiable expectation if possible.

## Baseline / comparison

What should this be compared against?

## Method

Describe the proposed experiment, workload, dataset, or reproduction.

## Metrics

What will count as evidence? Include quality, cost, time, human attention, security, or community metrics where relevant.

## Resource budget / stopping rule

How much compute/time/data should be used, and when should the experiment stop?

## Threats to validity

What could make the result misleading?

## Community Impact

Can other contributors reproduce or extend the experiment? What documentation or tooling is needed to make that possible?

## Related work / references

Add links or citations where useful.
